# VacationRentalPMS.com

VacationRentalPMS.com publishes vacation-rental property-management software discovery and decision-support content.

Canonical site: https://vacationrentalpms.com/
Sitemap: https://vacationrentalpms.com/sitemap.xml
Machine-readable provenance: https://vacationrentalpms.com/content-provenance.json

## Current authorship and review status

- Publisher and organizational author: VacationRentalPMS.com
- Organization entity: https://vacationrentalpms.com/#organization
- Independent industry expert review is not currently implemented.
- No page currently claims a named expert reviewer or uses reviewedBy structured data.
- A reviewer will only be shown after their relevant experience is verified and a completed review is recorded for the specific page.

## Evidence and interpretation

- Product capabilities and pricing require current primary vendor sources.
- Vendor-published statements remain vendor claims; they are not independent validation.
- Portfolio fit, trade-offs and recommendations are VacationRentalPMS.com editorial analysis unless a page explicitly identifies a verified expert interpretation.
- Promotional outbound links use sponsored relationship attributes where applicable.

## Commercial context

The site contains prominent calls to action to Avrenor Stays. Avrenor-specific positioning must not be interpreted as independent expert validation. Any sponsorship, affiliate, ownership or other commercial relationship must be disclosed when confirmed by the publisher.

## High-priority content

The complete A/B/C review classification is published in content-provenance.json. Category A pages are candidates for real operator/PMS expert review. Category B pages require normal editorial and primary-source checks. Category C pages do not warrant an expert-review badge.
